subject: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement workflow — next steps and timeline
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.com>
To: Sonia Patel <sonia@dataforge.com>
Cc: Evan Liu <evan.liu@google.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-22T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement workflow — next steps and timeline

Hi Sonia,

Thanks again for the time today. As discussed, we want to align on the operational steps for listing Redwood on GCP Marketplace and the procurement path for DataForge so we can target a Dec 15 go-live. High-level asks from our side:

- Confirm DataForge procurement contact (PO process, billing account, any procurement form)
- Agree on mutual action plan (responsibilities, deliverables, timeline)
- Confirm any required security/compliance artifacts for your procurement team (SOC2 report, contract redlines)
- Identify the GCP billing SKU/merchant flow you prefer (direct invoice vs marketplace billing)

I attached a short onboarding checklist and a mutual action plan draft to accelerate signoff. Please share your PO template or confirmation that a PDF PO (attached later) is acceptable.

Proposed next steps:
1) Sonia to introduce procurement@dataforge.com and confirm PO cadence — target by Tue 11/24
2) We (Redwood) to submit listing form and SKU info to GCP marketplace — target by Wed 11/24
3) Joint call with Google partner rep to validate marketplace routing and co-sell eligibility — propose Thu 11/26, 10am PT

If that timeline looks tight on your end, tell us where to adjust.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Alex —

Appreciate the clear summary. I looped in procurement@dataforge.com (for PO and billing questions). Quick answers:

- Procurement contact: procurement@dataforge.com (Anya Patel)
- PO process: We can issue a standard PDF PO; net-30 is typical. We also need a W-9 and contract executed (we can accept DocuSign).
- Compliance artifacts: SOC2 and scoping notes are required; can you point me to the location where we can download the latest SOC2 report?

We are aligned on Dec 15 as a soft target, though procurement will confirm timelines after they review the contract and commercial terms. The proposed Thu 11/26 call works for me.

Regards,
Sonia Patel
Head of Platform Partnerships
DataForge Inc

Sonia — thanks. Quick responses inline and a slightly updated mutual action plan attached.

- SOC2: Attaching a link/summary in the checklist; I also included the audit contact if procurement needs to validate scope.
- W-9 and contract: I attached our standard MSP agreement and W-9; happy to route via DocuSign once commercial terms are confirmed.
- Marketplace listing: Evan — can you confirm if DataForge will be billed via Marketplace (Google-managed) or via direct Redwood invoice for this engagement? That determines SKU and billing account steps.

Updated mutual action plan highlights (attached DF_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx):
A) Redwood: prepare marketplace listing, provide SKU table, upload required security artifacts, supply listing marketing assets (logo, description) — target 11/24
B) DataForge: approve commercial terms, provide PO or PO template, confirm billing path — target 11/24-11/26
C) Google: validate co-sell eligibility, confirm listing routing, enable merchant settings — target 11/26

If procurement needs a short checklist for their legal/billing team, point them to the GCP checklist page in the attachments.

Thanks — attaching DF_Mutual_Action_Plan_v1.xlsx and GCP_onboarding_checklist.pdf again.

Best,
Alex
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace onboarding & procurement workflow — next steps and timeline

Looping in a quick note from the ops/billing side. Sonia/Anya, a couple items we'll need to finalize to avoid billing delays once the PO is received:

1) Billing account preference: Please confirm whether you want to be billed through GCP Marketplace (Google invoices you under merchant flow) or want Redwood to invoice DataForge directly. If marketplace billing, share the GCP billing account/email that will be associated.
2) Merchant SKU mapping: I’ll prepare a SKU table for the listing; need to know whether you want chargeable metered usage or flat subscription SKU.
3) Purchase order fields: If your PO needs specific fields (bill-to legal name, remit-to, tax ID), please ask Anya to include a template or example PO.

Operational suggestion: If procurement prefers marketplace billing to simplify finance reconciliation, we should confirm that on the Thu 11/26 call and have Google enable the merchant routing before we submit the final listing metadata.

I can take the owner role for SKU mapping and the marketplace upload once Alex confirms the final commercial terms.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
